description: This file defines data models used in a financial expense tracking application, including classes for reporting aggregations such as PeriodTotals, CategoryBreakdown, and TimeSeriesPoint, with methods for serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: PeriodTotals
classes.description: Represents aggregated income and expense totals over a period, with methods for conversion to/from map and copying.

classes.name: CategoryBreakdown
classes.description: Represents a category-specific financial breakdown, including ID, name, color, total amount, and income/expense flag.

classes.name: TimeSeriesPoint
classes.description: Represents a point in a time series chart with timestamp and associated income/expense amounts.

methods.name: PeriodTotals.fromMap
methods.description: Creates an instance from a raw database aggregate row.

methods.name: PeriodTotals.toMap
methods.description: Converts the instance into a map suitable for serialization or database storage.

methods.name: PeriodTotals.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the instance with optional updated fields.

methods.name: CategoryBreakdown.fromMap
methods.description: Creates an instance from a database aggregate row for a category.

methods.name: CategoryBreakdown.toMap
methods.description: Converts the instance into a map for serialization.

methods.name: CategoryBreakdown.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy with optional modifications.

methods.name: TimeSeriesPoint.fromMap
methods.description: Creates an instance from a database row representing a time series point.

methods.name: TimeSeriesPoint.toMap
methods.description: Serializes the time series point to a map.

methods.name: TimeSeriesPoint.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy with optional modifications.
